name: Appalachian Basin onshore production, monthly per facility
description: Facility-level monthly production for the production-appalachia layer: every well the state files reported in the trailing 120 months, with surface coordinates, current, prior and last-year readings, a ten-year summary, field and county clusters, and on-demand history shards. Current = the newest complete filing month, by rule.
license_note: Public record of the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection; GreenPort states no licence and the pa.gov disclaimer covers warranty only; figures as reported by operators

shards.note: Built alongside the index from the archived workbooks (O1, option a); a checkout without them shows the index and says so in the dossier.

eia.name: oil
eia.description: Pennsylvania Field Production of Crude Oil (Thousand Barrels)

completeness.rule: newest month whose count of facilities that filed is at least the threshold share of the median over the preceding lookback of months, that median being at least the floor share of the median over the lookback before it
completeness.reporterRule: unconventional wells present in the month’s extract (filed a report)

reconciliation.note: State filings are gross gas at the wellhead as reported by operators; EIA gross withdrawals include estimates for wells the state file omits (confidential wells, late filers), marketed production excludes gas flared, vented and used for repressuring. Region totals exclude nothing the files carry.

assumptions.transform: none — NAD83 and WGS84 agree within two metres in Pennsylvania
assumptions.reporterRule: unconventional wells present in the month’s extract (filed a report)
assumptions.finality: a live report: DEP notes values may change between generations of reports, so --refresh re-reads every month

reproduce.raw_archive: Every workbook is archived verbatim under .gev-cache/onshore/<state>/ (git-ignored) with a .retrieved sidecar; parsed rows are cached beside it keyed by sha256; --replay rebuilds from the archive, --check diffs against the committed bytes.
